steps.name: every link on the site resolves
steps.check: (async () => { const bad = []; for (const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')) { const u = new URL(a.href, location.href); if (u.origin !== location.origin) continue; const r = await fetch(u, { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!r.ok) bad.push(`${u.pathname} ${r.status}`); } return bad.join(', '); })()
